meta.note: Evidence, not a verdict. stored false: no stored submission matches the link, so the review is the live read of the GitHub repo alone, with no stored checks, similar submissions or pitch. judging = each of the event's judging criteria, in its record's words, with the evidence a judge would find in the repo, read live from GitHub (repo.readAt), or checkable false with the reason.
